nodes.label: Strava OAuth Token Setup (Step 2)
nodes.rationale: The Strava tutorial's example authorization URL uses scope=read only, which is insufficient. profile:read_all must be added (scope=read,activity:read_all,activity:write,profile:read_all) so the app can detect bikes with no recorded rides yet.

nodes.label: Dev/Staging/Master Branch Workflow
nodes.rationale: Development happens in dev branch; changes ready for testing merge to staging for QA; only after QA succeeds do changes merge to master, with a new SemVer tag created during PR review before the master merge. This acts as a quality gate before release.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Auto-Update Mechanism
nodes.rationale: A post-commit git hook (installed via 'graphify hook install', not tracked by git under .git/hooks/) rebuilds graph.json/GRAPH_REPORT.md from changed code using AST-only analysis with no LLM cost. Doc/template/image content is not covered by the hook and needs a manual 'graphify . --update' run, since that step requires either a Gemini API key or an LLM-capable session.

nodes.label: Q1 2025 Piloting Program
nodes.rationale: Software is under active development and used at the pilot's own risk; the automated onboarding flow is not ready yet, so users must set up the app manually via a documented multi-step procedure.

nodes.label: v0.4.2 Release
nodes.rationale: Breaking change to data model/DB schema (mandatory component types, max quantities); requires running db_migration.py and backing up the database first.

nodes.label: v0.4.3 Release
nodes.rationale: Breaking change to data model/DB schema introducing workplans and incident reports; requires running db_migration.py and backing up the database first.

nodes.label: v0.4.5 Release
nodes.rationale: Breaking change to data model/DB schema introducing the Collections feature and the first draft of the help page/user docs; requires running db_migration.py and backing up the database first.

nodes.label: v0.4.7 Release
nodes.rationale: Breaking change to data model/DB schema introducing hybrid time+distance tracking and user-configurable thresholds; requires running db_migration.py and backing up the database first.

nodes.label: v0.4.9 Release (Current)
nodes.rationale: Breaking change to data model/DB schema integrating workplans, incidents and service records around workplans as a hub; requires running db_migration.py and backing up the database first.

nodes.label: Rename read_database_connection to check_database_connection
nodes.rationale: read_* methods return raw data; this returns a (success, message) tuple, mirroring the business_logic pass-through

nodes.label: Catching peewee.DatabaseError for corrupt file
nodes.rationale: sqlite3 raises DatabaseError, not OperationalError, for 'file is not a database'; documented in docstring so it is not 'fixed' to match the rest of the file

nodes.norm_label: a5: workplan delete blocked while services linked
nodes.rationale: Incident links exist only through services, so a deletable workplan has no incident links

nodes.label: D2: incident modal lists linked services
nodes.norm_label: d2: incident modal lists linked services
nodes.rationale: A service belongs to at most one incident and one workplan; an incident can span many services across many workplans

nodes.label: Warn (not block) when resolving incident with planned services
nodes.norm_label: warn (not block) when resolving incident with planned services
nodes.rationale: App only blocks where data would end up inconsistent; an incident can genuinely be resolved with follow-up work still planned

nodes.label: Date picker form.onsubmit wrapper fix
nodes.rationale: Wrapper called form.submit() itself once dates looked valid, bypassing preventDefault from other submit listeners; now blocks only on invalid input. Highest-risk change since it is on every form with a date field
